articles.title: Investigation Launched After Fire at Illegal Waste Site in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: The Environment Agency has confirmed an investigation following a significant fire at an illegal waste site in Smallbridge, Rochdale, which required extensive firefighting efforts.
articles.content_html:
An investigation has been launched following a fire at a waste site in Rochdale. Crews worked throughout the night on July 24 after a fire broke out off Spring Mill Walk, in Smallbridge.

Firefighters were called to the scene at 8.15pm and worked until around 1pm the following day. Thick plumes of smoke were visible for miles around, prompting a significant response from emergency services, including six fire engines and specialist equipment to extinguish the fire.

The Environment Agency became involved due to the large quantity of waste at the site. In an update issued on August 1, the agency confirmed that the fire occurred at an illegal waste site, which is now under investigation following the incident.

Residents in the surrounding area were advised to keep their windows and doors closed during the firefighting efforts. Dramatic images from the scene showed the scale of the operation faced by firefighters last weekend.
